name: Bollinger Band reversion
description: Buy when price closes below the lower band, sell when it returns to the middle.

about.how_it_works: Bollinger Bands sit two standard deviations from a 20-bar average, so a close below the lower band is unusually far from normal. The bet is that price snaps back toward the average (the middle band).
about.works_best: Range-bound markets that oscillate around a stable level.
about.fails_when: A strong trend starts: in a breakdown, price can ride the lower band for a long time. The stop limits that damage.
